messages:
maria: Heads-up — kickoff for AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace preflight. Need IAM account mappings, SKU naming, and packaging manifest agreed before legal review.

alex: +1. Can we lock SKU namespace and billing dimensions today? I want to avoid renames.

gokul: For infra, we need the exact AWS publisher account ID and GCP project owner. Also confirm whether we use marketplace-managed entitlements or our own licensing.

maria: AWS acct is 123456789012 (publisher). GCP project tentative: redwood-marketplace-prod. Jordan, legal: are we ok with marketplace-managed entitlements for all three clouds?

jordan: Prefer marketplace-managed for AWS/GCP for faster go-live, but Azure has some DOC/contract quirks. Need to add a short addendum for Azure commercial marketplace. Filing now.

sam: Packaging note — we'll produce two artifact flavors: "pay-as-you-go" and "subscription-commit". Suggest SKU suffixes: -payg, -commit. Example: redwood-inf-payg-v1.

alex: Good pattern. Can we include billing_dimensions = ["tokens", "embedding_units"] in the manifest? Some customers want cost breakdown.

gokul: Tech checklist for each cloud:
- IAM roles + publisher account mapping
- Entitlement model (marketplace vs own)
- Offer/Listing metadata (logo, long/short description, terms link)
- AMI/container image digest or GCP artifact registry URL
- SKU schema and pricing tiers

maria: I'll own metadata and logos. Alex you own SKU/price tiers. Gokul infra owns IAM + deployment artifact URIs. Jordan owns contract addendum. Sam helps with packaging artifacts.

marketplace-bot: Reminder: listing submission window opens in 3 business days. Required fields: legal_contact, technical_contact, pricing_table.

jordan: Uploaded draft addendum to drive: https://drive.redwood/example-adendum (please comment). Key ask: explicit data residency & SLA paragraph for enterprise customers.

sam: For the manifest, proposing a top-level JSON field: `billing_dimensions` and `sku_id`. Quick example:
```json
{"sku_id":"redwood-inf-payg-v1","billing_dimensions":["tokens","embedding_units"],"pricing":{"usd_per_1k_tokens":0.60}}
```

alex: That example looks good. One ask — include `compatibility`: ["dedicated","private","hosted"] so marketplace UI can surface options.

gokul: For AWS AMI listing we need: AMI ID (region-specific), launch permissions, and an install script that sets up KMS integration. I'll paste a snippet later.

maria: Action items: (1) Alex finalize SKU list & pricing by EOD — include compatibility field. (2) Gokul provide artifact URIs + IAM snippet by EOD. (3) Jordan finalize addendum + send to marketplace legal by EOD. (4) Sam generate packaging manifest template and upload to the shared repo.

alex: On it. I'll post a CSV in the thread when done.

gokul: Will also run a quick validation script to check AMI digests across regions. If anyone needs the script, ping me.

jordan: Filing comments on the addendum now. If the marketplace requests changes we'll escalate.

maria: Thanks everyone — let's sync next in the partnerships weekly at 3pm if we need a follow-up. :thumbsup:

marketplace-bot: Note: keep asset filenames under 5MB and include alt text for logos.
